subject: LightMesh SDK integration — trace/telemetry collaboration and commercial terms
messages:
From: Asha Narang <asha@lightmesh.ai>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com
Cc: Elliot Shaw <elliot@lightmesh.ai>
Date: Tue, 29 May 2028 16:12:00 +0000
Subject: Redwood + LightMesh — lightweight SDK telemetry integration proposal

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for taking the intro last week. LightMesh builds an embeddable SDK that adds runtime tracing and prompt-level telemetry to LangChain / LlamaIndex integrations — happy-path is collecting request/response events, KV-cache deltas, and inferred prompt templates. We think there’s a strong fit to make LightMesh an endorsed integration in Redwood’s marketplace and to certify a "Redwood-ready" SDK profile that preserves low latency and minimal memory tax.

Attached: LightMesh_Integration_Proposal_v1.pdf (high-level technical approach, sample telemetry payloads, and a two-phase roll plan).

Commercial ask in short: co-sell + marketplace listing, a modest revenue-share for referrals, and engineering support credits (3 weeks) from Redwood to complete runtime performance testing on Dedicated pools.

Can we sync with the appropriate product & partnerships folks this week? Proposed attendees: you, someone from infra/serving (trace integration), and Vanessa for go-to-market.

Best,
Asha
Partner Lead, LightMesh
[Attachment: LightMesh_Integration_Proposal_v1.pdf (pdf)]

From: kimberly_park@redwood.com
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Asha Narang <asha@lightmesh.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Redwood + LightMesh — lightweight SDK telemetry integration proposal

Forwarding LightMesh's note — short summary and asks below.

What they want:
- Certification/marketplace listing of LightMesh SDK as "Redwood-ready" for LangChain & LlamaIndex use cases.
- 2-phase technical rollout: sandbox validation (perf + correctness) then a limited GA on Dedicated pools.
- Commercial: marketplace revenue-share + co-sell; 3 weeks engineering support from Redwood for performance tuning.

Risks/notes:
- Their payloads include prompt tokens + partial responses. We need to confirm data residency & retention compatibility with Private deployments.
- Potential added latency if instrumentation is naive — need kernel-level or async batching guidance.

Asks:
1) Vanessa — can you outline a suggested commercial framework (referral vs revenue share, listing fees)?
2) Karthik — can your team evaluate the acceptance checklist in ~3 business days?
3) Marissa — could this be an ISV partner candidate for our next marketplace batch?

I attached their proposal and a starter SOW that I drafted (Redwood-LightMesh_SOW_draft.docx).

Thanks — want to circle today at 2pm PT if possible.

— Kimberly
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood-LightMesh_SOW_draft.docx (docx)]

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: Asha Narang <asha@lightmesh.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 10:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood + LightMesh — lightweight SDK telemetry integration proposal

Kimberly / team — quick commercial sketch below, happy to refine in the 2pm sync.

Commercial framework (initial):
- Marketplace listing: no up-front fee; LightMesh pays a 10% revenue share on paid referrals (12 months post-referral).
- Co-sell credits: shared lead registration + standard partner MDF terms.
- Engineering support: we commit 3 weeks of senior infra time (estimated 120 engineer-hours) billed as partner credits; additional work billed at T&M or via a scoped SOW.
- Launch promotion: featured in our partner newsletter + a joint webinar (cost split).

Contract asks from legal side: indemnity limits aligned to our standard ISV partner agreement, and explicit data handling sections for telemetry payloads. I’ll start a short commercial memo after the meeting and loop legal.

Marketing/go-to-market: Marissa — I think this maps to our observability & SDK category. If we accept, we should aim to complete sandbox validation by EOM June and GA in early August. Are there conflicts with the current marketplace intake?

— Vanessa
Sr. Director, Partnerships, Redwood Inference
[Inline: proposed commercial bullet list]

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
To: kimberly_park@redwood.com, vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Cc: Asha Narang <asha@lightmesh.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 May 2028 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood + LightMesh — lightweight SDK telemetry integration proposal

Thanks — read through the proposal attachment and sketched an initial acceptance checklist (attached as sdk-trace-acceptance-checklist.md). Key engineering notes / constraints:

1) Trace surface: we can accept SDK events that are strictly request/response metadata + non-sensitive prompt template ids, but full prompt text MUST be optional and opt-in per customer. For Private deployments we require a data retention TTL and KMS tagging support.

2) Performance: target <5% p99 token-latency overhead on Dedicated profiles. To achieve that we need async, batched telemetry emission and an option to disable instrumentation at token-level across hot paths.

3) Compatibility: we’ll provide a small runtime shim (hosted as an open-source helper) for LangChain and LlamaIndex connectors. LightMesh will add a Redwood profile to the SDK and include an automated test harness that runs against our dedicated sandbox (we will provide access).

4) Security/compliance: require SOC2 section in their pen-test report + an integration checklist item for encryption-in-flight and at-rest for telemetry queues.

If we can get a signed SOW that includes the three weeks of partner-engineering and a test plan, engineering can start the sandbox runs the week of 6/10.

I attached the checklist and a short sample harness snippet. Happy to walk the LightMesh engineers through the runtime edge cases after the call.

— Karthik
Principal Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: sdk-trace-acceptance-checklist.md (md)]
